mapper.select: select a.activity_num, a.activity_name, a.activity_begintime, a.activity_endtime from participate p, activity a where p.activity_num = a.activity_num and p.volunteer_num = #{volunteerNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} and p.participate_isdeleted = 0 and p.participate_applystate in ('0', '1', '3') and a.activity_isdeleted = 0 and (a.activity_endtime is null or a.activity_endtime > now())
